title: Font Manager glyph trait catalog
description: The distinctive glyph traits the detectors compute and the letter picker shows (E49): one entry per trait, each with its values, their labels and a drawn example.

labels.description: Friendly text by language: en and de are required; other two-letter languages may follow.

example.description: An SVG path (the d attribute) drawn as a stroke, without fill, in a 56 × 56 box (viewBox 0 0 56 56). Absolute commands only (M L H V C S Q T A Z); every number lies in 0–56.

id.description: The glyph's name and the trait, joined by a dot (R.leg, one.flag). Unique.

script.description: ISO 15924 script of the glyph (Latn; Cyrl and Grek later).

glyph.description: The character the trait is measured on: exactly one Unicode scalar value.

codepoint.description: The glyph's code point, U+ and four to six uppercase hex digits; the same character as glyph.

kind.description: enum: the detector picks one value. scalar: the detector measures numbers, and the first value whose when conditions hold is the chip.

enabled.description: Whether the picker and the search offer the trait (default true). A trait whose detector misses the accuracy bar on the labelled corpus (E49.4) is false: it is still detected and stored, so enabling it later needs no new pass.

measures.description: Scalar traits only: the numbers the detector measures.

when.description: Scalar traits only: the thresholds that map the measures to this chip, all of which must hold (min inclusive, max exclusive). Values are tried in order; the last one has an empty list and catches the rest.
